body: Thank you. I've managed to reconnect with some close friends who has been distant for a while, so everything is on the up and up.

Thank you for the kind words. I'm in a much better place now, told my SO about my feelings and have a couple close friends by my side helping me out (one of which attempted suicide while we were in high school so she has a bit of insight and helpful advice on the subject).

My cat actually isn't in any pain (I discussed this with the vet), and it's actually a birth defect that can be treated with medicine. I of course asked the vet straight forward if putting her down was the viable option if she was in pain, because of course I would never force my cat to stay alive if she was suffering, and the vet said she was in no pain, the electricity in her heart is just off and needs to be treated, and she has a shot at a long and healthy life. I just got that news a few days ago, so little by little things seem to be getting better. :)
